audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart said Yasuo at Level 2 and Skill at Level 3 and Levels 4-5, contradicting the packet chart (Aatrox for levels 1-5), the mirror audit, and this page's own whys[1..3] which all state Aatrox is ahead there.
audit.why: Aatrox's The Darkin Blade (Q) chain plus Deathbringer Stance (P) healing out-trades Yasuo before he has E at 3 and items later; Yasuo has no knockup partner for Last Breath until Q2 stacks land.
audit.corrected: Levels 1, 2, 3, 4-5 and 6 read Aatrox; First item and 2+ items read Yasuo. Both layers (phases[N].side and win[N]) proposed as one atomic group.

audit.why: Spikes are correctly placed: Aatrox at 3-5 and at 6 with World Ender (R, 120/100/80s), Yasuo at first crit item and late. Only the reasoning inside them needed fixing, not the timings.
audit.corrected: Kept the four spike windows; tightened spikes[0], spikes[2] and spikes[3] text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three places claimed Wind Wall (W) blocks The Darkin Blade: spikes[0] 'Wind Wall (W) can eat his Q edge damage', spikes[2] 'Wind Wall fully negates his Q ranged damage', late 'wall his ranged damage'.
audit.why: The Darkin Blade is a sword slam with an area of effect, not a projectile. Riot's kit flags mark projectile only on Infernal Chains (W) — that is the one Wind Wall deletes. The mirror audit on aatrox already applied this same correction from the other side.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall blocks Infernal Chains and nothing else in his kit; The Darkin Blade must be side-stepped. Also added the missing anti-heal line (Deathbringer Stance, Umbral Dash and World Ender all heal) and the Deathbringer auto-reset wind-up tell.

audit.why: The packet flagged "World Ender's" in spikes[3] as a probable wrong ability name. It is a false positive — it is the correct possessive of World Ender.

edits.before: E dashes through minions make you untouchable in the wave. Only take the trade when Aatrox's The Darkin Blade is down.
edits.after: Aatrox's Q edge damage out-trades you and you lack E until 3. Wind Wall is 25s at rank 1 — hold it for Infernal Chains.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Aatrox must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: E is online but his full Q1-Q2-Q3 chain plus Deathbringer healing still out-trades you. Keep the wave near your side and farm.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around The Darkin Blade's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His Q hits 8s at rank 4 and heals through your chip, so trade only in that gap. Bank small leads, freeze if ahead, farm safe if behind.

edits.before: Aatrox owns this window: his Q1-Q2-Q3 chain and Deathbringer Stance healing let him trade through your poke while you have no mobility until E at level 3. Wind Wall (W) can eat his Q edge damage but it's on a huge cooldown early, so don't waste it on a whiffed swing. Bait the third Q — its sweet-spot knockup is what actually punishes you — then E away before it lands.
edits.after: Aatrox owns this window: his Q1-Q2-Q3 chain and Deathbringer Stance healing let him trade through your poke while you have no mobility until E at level 3. Wind Wall does not stop The Darkin Blade — the sword swing is not a projectile — so save its 25s cooldown for Infernal Chains (W). Bait the third Q; its sweet-spot knockup is what punishes you, then walk out sideways.

edits.before: This is where you flip it. Once you finish a crit item (IE/Shieldbow) your Q crits and E-Q resets start chunking him faster than his Deathbringer heals, and Wind Wall fully negates his Q ranged damage in a committed fight.
edits.after: This is where you flip it. Once you finish a crit item (IE/Shieldbow) your Q crits and E-Q resets chunk him faster than Deathbringer Stance heals, and Executioner's Calling cuts that healing before you commit the all-in.

edits.before: Skirmisher Yasuo out-DPS's Aatrox with items and Wind Wall shuts down a huge chunk of his kit; you kite his Q sweet-spots with E and burst him before World Ender's healing matters. Just avoid getting pillared against a wall for the airborne combo.
edits.after: Skirmisher Yasuo out-DPS's Aatrox with items, and Wind Wall eats Infernal Chains so he cannot drag you back into a Q sweet-spot; kite the swings with E and burst him before World Ender's healing matters. Avoid getting pinned against a wall.

edits.before: Once your first crit item lands the matchup flips: your crit Q, E resets and Wind Wall out-DPS his healing. Kite his Q knockups, wall his ranged damage, and burst him before World Ender matters.
edits.after: Once your first crit item lands the matchup flips: your crit Q and E resets out-damage his healing. Kite the Q swings, wall Infernal Chains, and buy anti-heal before World Ender matters.

edits.before: With your first crit item your Q crits and Wind Wall out-DPS his Deathbringer healing.
edits.after: With your first crit item and Executioner's Calling your crit Q out-damages his healing.

edits.before: Late, Skirmisher Yasuo kites his Q and walls his damage to win the duel.
edits.after: Late, Skirmisher Yasuo kites his Q swings and walls Infernal Chains to duel.

edits.before: Aatrox wastes The Darkin Blade — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Deathbringer Stance glows first — step back on the wind-up, then commit.

notes: Packet defect 'World Ender's' is a false positive (correct possessive). Mirror findings summary says 'Levels 1 through First item all read Aatrox', but the packet levelChart says First item is Yasuo and the content whys[5] agrees (crit item flips the lane); I followed the packet and whys. If mirror-fix.js later forces First item to Aatrox, whys[5], spikes[2] and late will need re-wording to match.
